label: Illustrative product and engineering backlog derived from the synthetic work queue.

items.title: Validate mandatory identifiers before case creation
items.change: Add source-level required-field validation and return a structured correction request before the steward queue.
items.success_measure: Track missing-identifier cases per 100 onboarding requests and first-pass yield before and after a separately measured release.

items.title: Add a hierarchy-conflict evidence panel
items.change: Show competing parent values, source lineage and effective dates together; require steward rationale and independent approval to resolve.
items.success_measure: Track hierarchy exceptions by age, rework and downstream breaks; do not auto-select a parent from precedence alone.

items.title: Make cross-hub handoffs explicit
items.change: Require receiving owner, reason and next-action date at handoff; surface unaccepted handoffs in the daily queue review.
items.success_measure: Track unaccepted handoffs and time between assignment and acceptance by workflow and hub.
